newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,164 to dollar for August 29 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,164 to dollar for August 29 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,164 to the dollar for August 29.
This reference rate was set on Tuesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for August 28 is 3,161 to the dollar. It was 3,158 on Tuesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
